Alongside all of the early Prime Day deals now live, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by rare early Prime Day deals on Apple Watch Ultra 3 at nearly $100 off (additional colors and band options are now live), alongside ongoing Series 11 discounts starting from $299 with up to $160 in savings. We also have a rare deal on this entry 1TB M5 MacBook Pro with the official 96W Apple charger upgrade live at $200 off alongside Apple’s mid-range 512GB M5 iPad Pro back down to one of its best prices today at nearly $150 off, and this load of Beats headphones at up to $220 off via Best Buy. Head below for a closer look.

Rare early Prime Day deals hit Apple Watch Ultra 3 at nearly $100 off (More colors and band options now live)

Alongside the $100 to $160 price drops still live across the Series 11 lineup, rare Apple Watch Ultra 3 deals are landing this week at nearly $100 off. We caught a couple colors and band options already a few days ago, but Amazon is adding new models to the list this morning including the super slick all-black model with the matching Milanese Loop and this Natural with the blue Trail Loop. Check them out, alongside the other configs on sale below.

Last night we caught the Natural Ultra 3 with the Anchor Blue Ocean Band dropping in price, and now Amazon has now added a couple more options to the $99 off party:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Ocean Band $700 (Reg. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Milanese Loop $800 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Natural Milanese Loop $800 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Blue Trail Loop $700 (Reg. $799)

While the $99 price drops might not seem like a ton, this is only the second time Ultra 3 has been on sale all year. Today’s deals land on par with last year’s Black Friday deal and have only been beaten out once when select configs were $120 off for a few hours as Black Friday wrapped up in 2025.

If the Ultra 3 is a bit much for your needs, scope out this refurb Ultra 2 deal at $420 off the original list price and then dive into the aforementioned Series 11 discounts live this week starting from $299 instead:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $299 (Reg. $399) – All colors

Rare deal on entry 1TB M5 MacBook Pro with 96W Apple charger upgrade live at $200 off

The Amazon Prime Day M5 and M5 Pro MacBook Pro deals are presumably still on the way, but you won’t be able to score this M5 MacBook Pro bundle with the upgraded 96W Apple charger at $200 off there anyway.

B&H is now offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB SSD down at $1,519 shipped. You’re looking at the base model M5 machine but with the official 96W Apple Power Adapter charger upgrade – this makes this setup a regularly $1,719 investment that is now $200 off the list price.

Amazon does sells this same machine, and we have seen it down at $1,499 once (currently down at $1,549). It, however, includes the standard 70W charger instead of the more powerful 96W model B&H is shipping it with today. We safely assume Amazon will bring the price back down to $1,499 on the entry M5, and potentially as soon as next week, but you will not be able to score it with the official 96W charger there – this is the same charger you can configure your M5 with at Apple for a $20 up-charge.

Prices are officially going up on Apple gear, Mr. Cook just said so himself and, while we don’t know when or on what, it might be a good idea to get a new machine or setup sooner than not – deal pricing is still based on the existing MSRPs and might not be nearly as notable in the future if Apple hikes the prices on existing releases.
